comparison.objective: Assemble a copper-pipe compression joint in the correct order and tighten its nut to a safe range with a spanner.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential pipe, olive and nut insertion followed by repeated spanner regrasping and controlled rotation; it does not maintain a rail-to-jig support bridge or contain free balls.
comparison.success_condition: Requires pipe home, olive under the nut, 0.75–1.25 turns past snug, no over-compression and tool return; candidate requires complete linear transfer, all balls contained and no gap, inclination, contamination or damage.
comparison.reason: Both use alignment and regrasping, but this record tests assembly order and bounded threaded tightening, not continuous support during an uncaged bearing handoff. Candidate numeric force, gap and angle thresholds are missing, without creating meaningful ambiguity here.
